description: This file contains unit tests for lifecycle management in the 'Tester' namespace, utilizing Xunit and testing various behaviors of lifecycle stages, observers, and participants, including failure scenarios.

classes.name: TestLifecycleSubject
classes.description: A test subclass of LifecycleSubject used for testing lifecycle behaviors.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Implements ILifecycleObserver; used to simulate observers that can fail on start or stop.

classes.name: MultiStageObserver
classes.description: Implements ILifecycleParticipant to participate in multiple lifecycle stages, tracking started and stopped states.

methods.name: FullLifecycleTest
methods.description: Tests the full lifecycle flow with multiple observers across different stages.

methods.name: FailOnStartOnEachStageLifecycleTest
methods.description: Tests lifecycle behavior when observers fail on start at each stage sequentially.

methods.name: FailOnStopOnEachStageLifecycleTest
methods.description: Tests lifecycle behavior when observers fail on stop at each stage.

methods.name: RunLifecycle
methods.description: Helper method to set up observers, run the lifecycle, and verify behaviors according to failure scenarios.
